## Checklist

- [ ] Conventional Commit title (`feat|fix|docs|chore|refactor|perf|test|ci`)
- [ ] Commits signed off (DCO, `git commit -s`)
- [ ] `make check` green locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Docs and docstrings updated for any public API change
- [ ] Benchmarks not regressed (`make bench`), or N/A
- [ ] ADR added for a structural decision, or N/A
